06 / BEFORE YOU GO

QUESTIONS?
LET’S TALK.

Find us at @spotra.ok
Is SPOTRA only for skaters?

SPOTRA brings together skate, BMX, roller and scooter riders. Find places, events and a community for your discipline.

What can I find on the map?

Spots, skateparks and shops. Check photos, information and directions, share places and discover community sessions.

Can I organize a session or an event?

The app lets you create sessions and events to meet other riders. Events include registration and a rankings section.

What is my SPOTRA ID?

It’s your rider identity on SPOTRA. Your profile, discipline, city, socials and content help you connect with the community and brands.

How do I manage my privacy?

SPOTRA has privacy controls, map presence settings, session alerts and tools to report or block users. Review your preferences in your profile.
